text:
marta: FYI ops asked for a short experiment to move some runtime defaults to safer, fail-open variants. want to sketch a low-risk rollout plan with preview UX, telemetry, and ledger entries.
jin: sounds fine. which flags are candidates? and per-team or global by default?
marta: candidates: quota-auto-throttle, route-strict-match, kv-eviction-policy. prefer per-team preview toggle first.
leo: per-team preview reduces blast radius. UI idea: 'Enable preview defaults' scoped to org/team + an Inspect Effects modal.
ops-bot: checklist created: ledger patch, preview toggle, preflight run, telemetry dashboard, OPA dry-run.
ci-bot: add e2e that validates representative routes (auth, uploads, websockets).
jin: telemetry: capture 0.5% traces + 10% counters, tag by route/team/flag. dashboard panels: preview-impact, errors-by-override.
marta: gating: stop progression if absolute error-rate delta > 0.3% or p95 latency +12%. also abort on auth 5xx increase.
leo: OPA dry-run results should feed a policy_violations_by_route chart and auto-pause if a route exceeds 20 violations in 1h.
ops-bot: PR template: add optional rollout_id and preview_scope to ledger v2. assign jin.
ci-bot: preflight script suggestion: `./bin/config-preview-check --from=prod --to=preview --sample routes.txt`
marta: canary plan: 5% teams for 4h, then 25% for 12h, then wider opt-in. manual approval required between stages.
leo: rollback runbook: revert per-route override, emit ledger rollback entry, notify #incidents, and provide one-click revert in console.
deploy-bot: started job: preview/dryrun-checker v2.1 -> canary (job 10021). :rocket:
marta: owners: ledger -> jin, dashboards -> marta, console UI -> leo, preflight/tooling -> ci-bot. scheduling a 30-min review after first window.
jin: small API note: sampling numbers use floats (0.5) for precision.
leo: good catch. everyone add subtasks to umbrella issue and sign off when green. :thumbsup:
